company.name: Product Science
company.shortDescription: Product Science is a performance management platform that helps improve mobile performance of apps.
company.description:
Product Science increases product metrics for mobile applications and helps apps work faster by providing insights into key performance issues that impact user experience. It analyzes the code and actual runtime data to pinpoint performance issues. Its AI enables them to do it more efficiently by providing unique insights for data visualizations to help mobile developers identify the problem right away. 

The company's integrated development environment tools and plugins display video recordings of apps alongside performance traces, providing insights into what's going on behind the screen.

Product Science was founded in 2021 and is based in Los Angeles, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Product Science is researching and developing systems and methods for analyzing software application performance, as described in 'System and method of analyzing software application performance.' The approach involves evaluating software performance by inserting trace markers into code to track when functions begin, end, and are scheduled for execution. This work focuses on improving the assessment and management of mobile app performance, reflecting the company's emphasis on performance management.
